description:

Ecksand's Aura is the embodiment of your own energy. It expands, intensifies, and transforms with you in an empowering ripple effect. These Diamond Pave Dangle Earrings with Reversible Half Moon Diamond Crescent are designed to shift with your intention. Style the earring's signature crescent to reveal half moon diamonds or diamond pave. Conceived by Creative Director Erica Bianchini and brought to life through the precision of Canadian craftsmanship, Aura reflects the Maison’s pursuit of form, innovation, and art of metamorphosis in fine jewelry.


Earrings dimensions: 21 mm x 7 approx. each
Natural Accent Diamonds: 0.70+ ctw, VS+/F+
Backing: Lever backs

title: Gold Crescent Conch Earring with Dangling Pear Diamonds and Cascading Crescent Studs
description:
Ecksand's Aura is the embodiment of your own energy. It expands, intensifies, and transforms with you in an empowering ripple effect. Conceived by Creative Director Erica Bianchini, this Gold Crescent Conch Earring captures energy in constant motion. Born of the Maison’s signature conch earring design, they require no additional piercing. Cascading Crescent Studs with diamond pave and polished gold accents connect behind the ear to the conch, accented with gold crescents and dangling pear-cut diamonds. Brought to life through the precision of Canadian craftsmanship, Aura reflects the Maison’s pursuit of form, innovation, and art of metamorphosis in fine jewelry.


Natural Accent Diamonds: 0.35+ ctw, VS+/F+
Post length: 11 mm approx.
Backing: Butterfly push backs
